what: Every mechanic a single staged board cannot settle, with the rate it must show and the denominator it must be measured over. The work list for the million-game run.
the_line: A RULE is settled by one board and belongs in the scenario catalogue. A DIE needs this run. A deterministic mechanic that only shows up wrong here means the catalogue has a hole, and fixing it here is the slow, late way round.
why_not_the_differential: engine/replay_differential.js pins every die identically over both engines. That is correct for finding a wrong RULE and fatal for a wrong RATE: pinning the outcome to what was observed makes a wrong probability agree with itself. Its --rates arm is designed and deferred for want of exactly this corpus.
denominator_warning: A rate over the wrong denominator is worse than no rate, because it looks like an answer. Every row states its own.
corpus_warning: A self-play corpus where nobody switches yields ZERO samples for Intimidate on entry, hazard chip and Regenerator however many games it runs. Coverage is a property of the action set, not of N.
not_here: preventsCrit (Battle Armor, Shell Armor, Disguise, Ice Face) is deliberately EXCLUDED: Storm Throw, Flower Trick and Frost Breath always crit, so one staged board settles those four without a die.

rows.subject: protect-chain
rows.denominator: CONSECUTIVE uses only — the counter resets the moment any other action succeeds, and Baneful Bunker / Spiky Shield / Silk Trap share one counter with Protect.

rows.subject: rockslide
rows.denominator: turns where rockslide CONNECTED with a target that could receive it — not turns where it was clicked. A miss, a Protect, a Substitute and an immunity are all outside the denominator, and Shield Dust / Covert Cloak suppress the roll itself.

rows.subject: rockslide
rows.denominator: attempts against a target that was not immune, protected or semi-invulnerable. Compound Eyes, Hustle, Victory Star, Tailwind-independent accuracy stages and Gravity all move the true rate, so those turns need their own bucket rather than pooling.

rows.subject: frz
